fact_text: A PSX notice on 3 June 2025 disclosed that Kot Addu Power may bid for Attock Cement together with Fauji Foundation, making the stake interest formal after earlier press reports.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: WAPDA holds about 40% of Kot Addu Power, and the company carries a large cash balance of about Rs 41 billion, which the analyst says lets it pursue projects, as the sponsor did at Hub Power.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: The analyst reads a Kot Addu and Fauji Foundation bid for Attock Cement as logical, since Kot Addu has cash and Fauji Foundation is a large investment arm that can buy into listed companies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: The analyst puts Attock Cement's enterprise value at about Rs 52 billion, so a 50-51% majority stake would cost roughly Rs 24-25 billion before allowing for the rest of the land and assets.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: A 50-51% majority stake in Attock Cement would cost about Rs 24-25 billion on the analyst's enterprise-value basis, a figure he uses to size the possible bid.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: Fauji Cement, part of the Fauji Foundation group, had a combination arrangement with Askari Cement about two to three years earlier, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: The analyst says Fauji Cement posted good performance in fiscal 2025 but its accounts do not show enough cash to fund Attock Cement on its own, so Fauji Foundation would be the more likely buyer route.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: K-Electric asked NEPRA for a tariff of about Rs 44 per kWh, a figure the analyst cites as the requested level before the multi-year tariff was set.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: K-Electric's collections improved in fiscal 2025, and the company reported this at its analyst briefing held at the PSX auditorium, which the analyst says supports a better earnings profile.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: The analyst expects K-Electric's customer base to grow as industrial users that had left the grid return to national electricity supply, which should improve its per-share earnings in later years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)

fact_text: Gradual reductions in distribution and transmission losses are a further factor the analyst expects to improve K-Electric's profile over time, though the tariff gap still weighs on earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Midday Flash 3 June 2025 |KAPCO & Fauji Foundation Plan Bid for Attock Cement? |KEL Analyst' (YouTube, 2025-06-03)
